seo.title: Illawarra Christian School | Excellent education, real faith
seo.description: A Prep–12 Christian school in Cordeaux Heights, Wollongong. Students do well, they're known by name, and they grow up in a Christian community that cares about them.

value.title: Excellent education, real faith and a community that knows your child.
value.text: Illawarra Christian School is a Prep-12 school in Cordeaux Heights, Wollongong. Our students do well, they're known by name, and they grow up in a Christian community that cares about them. Our fees are lower than you might expect for an independent school.
